text:
Maria: Quick sync — can we lock owners and rough timelines for the monthly recurrence sprint? I pulled the top recurring signatures from Q4 -> Q1 and sketched proposals. Need owners + acceptance criteria so PM can add to the sprint.

Ashok: Thanks — paste the short list? :eyes:

Maria: Sure — condensed: 
- autoscale lag during sudden traffic bursts (short spikes causing cold-start tails)
- KV cache churn leading to >95th pct tail latency on small requests
- model-variant fallback flapping (service flips between variants & increases error retries)

Tim: I can take autoscale lag. Proposed approach: telemetry + smoother warmup policy + a canary change to VM pool sizing. ETA 3 weeks. Acceptance: 99th pct latency on scale-up windows reduced to baseline + no regressions in throughput.

Leah: I'll own KV cache churn. Plan: add longer LRU pin for prefixes, instrument eviction heatmap, and adjust async prefetch for hot prefixes. ETA 2 weeks. Acceptance: 95th pct token latency down by 20% on cached paths.

Ashok: I'll pick up model-variant fallback. Suspect routing policy + insufficient compatibility matrix causing fallback loops. Plan: add a compatibility check, backoff on retries, and add circuit breaker to stop variant flip-flops. ETA 2 weeks.

IncidentBot: New postmortem added: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-03-08-autoscale-lag (PM-452)

Maria: Great. Please add a short ownership line to the postmortem comment section and link PRs. For tracking let's use the sprint epic `S-RECUR-2026-03`.

Tim: putting initial checklist in a draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/1042 — contains the warmup policy change + test harness. Will move to review by EOD Monday.

Leah: created a perf dashboard panel (dash id `dash-ops-179`) and a quick query for eviction spikes. Query: ```sql
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) AS t, count(*) FROM kv_evictions WHERE prefix = 'user:' AND ts > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Sharing results in the thread after we run it against prod sampling.

Ashok: I'll add the compatibility matrix doc to the repo and draft a fallback policy. Quick note: we should avoid heavy changes to routing until we have the regression harness; otherwise we'll create new flaps.

Maria: Action items (owner / due / acceptance):
- Tim / 2026-03-28 / 99th pct scale-up latency restored; PR merged
- Leah / 2026-03-21 / eviction heatmap + 20% 95th pct improvement
- Ashok / 2026-03-21 / compatibility check + circuit breaker live with metrics

Maria: Follow-up: 2026-03-22 sync @10:00am PT to review metrics & sign off canary. Please drop one-line updates in this thread as you progress.

Tim: noted, will update daily.

Leah: added task cards in Project board and linked dash. Will drop progress here. :white_check_mark:

Ashok: starting the compatibility doc now. If anyone sees new flaps, ping me directly.

Maria: Thanks — this looks good. If anything slips please flag early so we can defer lower-priority items.
